reviews.title: Keys not registering after less than 2 years use
reviews.comment: I've been using mechanical keyboards for 12 years, and for about the last 5 or 6 I've been using various Corsair RGB models.  When I needed a new one I didn't want to buy from Corsair again because I was unhappy with some of their other products and their iCue software, plus the fact I could no longer order one with Cherry Reds, so I decided to try this one.  Mistake.  It's now been less than 1.5 years and 2 keys (the e and the u) are intermittently either not registering or doubling/tripling.  Horribly annoying.  Add in the fact that a keyboard of this price should not be having problems in that short of a time and you get the one star rating.  I advise to avoid this junk.
reviews.author: Larry M.
